openbridge.description: Openbridge MCP server (FastMCP). Default production endpoint is https://mcp.openbridge.com/mcp/ and it runs in OAuth proxy mode (OPENBRIDGE_AUTH_MODE=oauth_proxy) — clients authenticate via a browser OAuth code flow rather than passing raw refresh tokens. Self-hosted instances may run in refresh_token mode (Bearer xxx:yyy or unexpired JWT). Code Mode default exposes meta-tools tags/search/get_schema/execute; CODE_MODE=false exposes the full direct catalog. Required tools listed below cover jobs, healthchecks, subscriptions, products/tables/schemas, rules, and remote identities. The SQL query tools (validate_query, execute_query) are CONDITIONALLY registered — only when OPENBRIDGE_ENABLE_LLM_VALIDATION=true and FASTMCP_SAMPLING_API_KEY (or OPENAI_API_KEY) is set. The skill detects them at runtime via get_capabilities() and falls back to schema-only output when they're absent.
